-- Local HTML sample queue read policy
--
-- Purpose:
--   Allow the local HTML prototype to read only the prepared 200-row sample
--   review queue with a browser publishable/anon key. This does not allow
--   decision writes and does not expose full production review queues.

grant usage on schema review to anon, authenticated
grant select on review.match_candidate_queue to anon, authenticated
grant select on review.match_candidate_details to anon, authenticated
drop policy if exists "match candidate queue sample readable by anon" on review.match_candidate_queue

create policy "match candidate queue sample readable by anon"
  on review.match_candidate_queue
  for select
  to anon
  using (
    source_batch_id in ('sample_smartstore_100', 'sample_makeshop_100')
  )
drop policy if exists "match candidate details sample readable by anon" on review.match_candidate_details

create policy "match candidate details sample readable by anon"
  on review.match_candidate_details
  for select
  to anon
  using (
    exists (
      select 1
      from review.match_candidate_queue q
      where q.queue_id = match_candidate_details.queue_id
        and q.source_batch_id in ('sample_smartstore_100', 'sample_makeshop_100')
    )
  )
